blurb: Met Links offers a restored Donald Ross-designed 9-hole golf course with a par-34 layout. Guests can participate in structured weekly golf leagues, special golf events, and host private golf outings. The course is known for its pristine conditions, friendly staff, and a laid-back atmosphere.
